name: Died of Mild Inconvenience
text: Reward: a coupon for nothing. Valid nowhere.

name: Frequent Returner
text: Five deaths. The returns bin now greets you by name.

name: Loyalty Card, Fully Stamped
text: Twenty-five deaths. Your next one is free. They were all free.

name: Mind the Step
text: Reached floor 2. Reward: the knowledge that there is a floor 3.

name: Below the Bargain Bin
text: Floor 5. Reward: a bookmark shaped like a slightly smaller bookmark.

name: Deep Catalogue
text: Floor 10. Nobody upstairs remembers you. Nobody upstairs remembered you before.

name: Out of Print
text: Floor 20. You are now officially hard to find. Collectors are interested.

name: Second Chapter
text: Level 2. Reward: a sense of momentum, lent, due back Tuesday.

name: Well Thumbed
text: Level 5. Your spine shows signs of use. That is a compliment, here.

name: Revised and Expanded
text: Level 10. Now with a new foreword by nobody.

name: Lucky Six
text: One critical. Reward: the die now winks at you. It will not do it again.

name: Rave Reviews
text: Ten criticals. A blurb about you reads: Competent. Occasionally.

name: Butterfingers
text: One fumble. Reward: a second, smaller pair of hands. Do not use them.

name: A Slapstick Classic
text: Ten fumbles. Now taught in clown school, as a warning.

name: Tactical Exit
text: Fled once. Reward: a medal, which you left behind in your hurry.

name: Personal Best
text: Fled twenty times. Your running shoes have filed a complaint.

name: First Blood, Mostly Ink
text: One kill. Reward: a sticker that says I Did A Violence. Peels at once.

name: Pest Control
text: Ten kills. The monsters have started a support group.

name: Pulp
text: Fifty kills. Everything you touch is now recycled paper.

name: Dewey Decimated
text: Two hundred kills. A whole classification system weeps quietly.

name: Named and Shamed
text: One boss down. Reward: their title, which does not fit you.

name: Series Finale
text: Five bosses. Each promised a sequel. None will get one.

name: Strongly Worded Letter
text: Talked one down. Your weapon of choice: a polite but firm tone.

name: Book Club Moderator
text: Ten talked down. Reward: a folding chair and nobody listening.

name: Read the Label
text: Used ten items. Reward: a warning sticker, applied to you.

name: Name Dropper
text: Visited five author rooms. You may now say you knew them before they were dead.

name: Power Nap
text: Rested ten times. Reward: a pillow stuffed with rejected manuscripts.

name: Window Shopper
text: Visited a shop. There is no window. Reward withdrawn.

name: Big Spender
text: Spent 100 coins. Reward: a receipt longer than most novels.

name: Patron of the Arts
text: Spent 1000 coins. A plaque in your honour, hung facing the wall.
